chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh and Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh, raising it, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
Indeed, Abū Ṭālib professed Islam by the accounting of al-jummal.

key_terms.أَبَا طَالِبٍ: Abū Ṭālib, the uncle of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الْجُمَّلِ: the alphanumeric numerical reckoning of letters
key_terms.بِحِسَابِ: by means of reckoning or calculation

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith indicate that Abū Ṭālib was Muslim?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Abū Ṭālib’s Islam is affirmed through the reckoning known as ḥisāb al-jummal, and that this indication holds universally across languages. It reflects a theological and historical affirmation related to the faith of Abū Ṭālib.
